pattern: Ultraviolet 3.2.10 script rewrite cost is ~half its generic AST walk (JS.prototype.iterate: for-in over every key incl. meriyah range arrays, closure per array) plus EventEmitter.emit per node, not the meriyah parse. public/uv/fast-walk.js overrides iterate/recast with identical visit order; verify any change with `pnpm test:uv <big.js>` (must stay byte-identical).

Ultraviolet serves worker-destination scripts with the page cookies and referrer of that moment prepended (createJsInject), so they must not be cached by URL; scripts, styles, fonts and images are URL-pure.

Ultraviolet original walk recurses 3 frames per array level and overflows the stack on deeply nested code (e.g. a 6000-term + chain); recast catches the error and returns the script unrewritten, leaking unproxied location/eval.
